attestations.note: The day’s fifth and last entry, FOUR SHORT SENTENCES. `dates` WRITTEN WHERE THE FOLDER HAD NONE AT ALL: «Упокојио се у Господу у другој половини VI столећа» is a half-century the book states for his repose, so it is recorded as a death of 551 to 600 displayed «late 6th century», which is the form `lib/date-display.js` parses; it is the corpus’s first year of any kind for him, the Romanian and Greek rows he already carries giving none. THE DISPLAY IS NOT THE BOOK’S OWN WORDS: the book says «the second half of the sixth century», and the test requires a form the reader’s parser knows, so «late» stands for «the second half of» and the book’s own phrase is quoted whole in the note. No `related` row: the entry names nobody. No `locations`: Nitria is named as the desert he was a monk of and the entry does not fix him at a place for a bounded span. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS, which is all of it: that he was a monk of Nitria; that he prayed to God day and night and enlightened himself by thinking on divine things; AND THAT HE DID NOT GO OUT OF HIS CELL, NOT EVEN OVER ITS THRESHOLD, FOR THIRTY-EIGHT FULL YEARS.

death.note: Охридски пролог за 27. новембар ст. ст.: «Упокојио се у Господу у другој половини VI столећа» — he fell asleep in the Lord in the second half of the sixth century. The display reads «late 6th century» and not the book’s own phrase because `tests/date-display.test.mjs` requires a form `lib/date-display.js` parses whole; the phrase itself is quoted here. It is the corpus’s first year of any kind for him: the folder held no `dates` object, and the Romanian and Greek calendars it is otherwise built on give him none.
